propositions: Removal of an exported public API (reachable via __all__, CLI command, or MCP tool) without a version/deprecation signal (major-version bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry) should trigger a 0.9 SERIOUS-tier impact boost in the deletion-impact/api-compat finding, scoring unversioned_published_contract_break as TRUE only for unmanaged removals.

The unversioned_published_contract_break classification must be version-signal-gated on both pass-2 surfaces (pydantic field description and code-review-verify prompt) to reflect whether a removal has a managed deprecation/version signal, making managed removals FALSE and unmanaged ones TRUE.

Frequency multiplier amplification for churn must reshape to [1.0..1.5] amplify-only, never suppressing scores; SERIOUS-tier findings must never be dampened by churn multiplier, preventing new/cold files from creating false negatives on critical changes.

Two new CodeSeverityAttrs boolean fields (removed_public_symbol and version_signal_present) must abstain safely when absent or set to False, providing targeted impact boost only when both the symbol is exported and the removal lacks a version signal, never lowering existing scores.

The citric-preregal-ladybird case (removed rebar.llm.review_ticket at impact 0.30, below the 0.60 deletion-impact / 0.51 api-compat flips) must achieve impact >= 0.60 with the corrected attributes and gating, validating the end-to-end scoring through packaged routing.

IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must bump from code-v4 to code-v5 to segment sidecars by semantics; eval-spec code-review-verify.yaml must add fire (unmanaged removal of exported public symbol) and no-fire (managed removal with deprecation cycle and CHANGELOG entry) test cases.
